decision.explanation: The question asks for the main character in the video game 'Who Framed Roger Rabbit'. The source documents describe two distinct versions of this game. Document 1 (D1S3) explicitly states that in the 1988 version (MS-DOS, etc.), 'The player controls Roger Rabbit'. Document 2 (D2S5) explicitly states that in the 1989 NES version, 'The player controls private detective Eddie Valiant'. Since both characters serve as the primary playable character ('main character') in their respective versions of the game, both are valid answers. The prompt instructions require preserving distinct valid referents and complementary answers rather than selecting a single 'winner'.
